shows.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup
shows.description: Portugal vs. Spain in a Round of 16 match in Arlington, Texas. Co-hosts of the 2030 World Cup collide for a berth in the quarterfinals, furthering their Iberian rivalry with a third World Cup meeting. Portugal's ageless Cristiano Ronaldo was involved in both previous games, a 1-0 Spain round-of-16 win in 2010 and a 3-3 draw in the 2018 group stage. La Roja have outscored their last three foes 8-0.
